faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions easily below.

questions.question: Can I also create a cover letter?
questions.answer: Yes, you can create a professional cover letter that matches your resume design perfectly.

questions.question: Can I download my Resume in another language (e.g. French)?
questions.answer: Yes, our builder supports multiple languages. You can change the language settings in the editor.

questions.question: How do I cancel my CVmaker.com account and subscription?
questions.answer: You can cancel your subscription easily through your account settings or by using the 'Cancel subscription' form on this page.

questions.question: Does it cost money to use CVmaker.com?
questions.answer: You can create a resume for free, but downloading it or using premium features may require a paid subscription.

questions.question: Can I hide an item on my Resume?
questions.answer: Yes, if you leave a field empty, it will automatically be hidden on your resume. You can also toggle visibility for entire sections.

questions.question: Can I put a section on the next page (in PDF)?
questions.answer: The layout is automatically optimized, but you can use the 'Page Break' feature to force a section to the next page.

questions.question: Are the items sorted chronologically?
questions.answer: By default, items like work experience and education are sorted reverse-chronologically (newest first), which is the standard.

questions.question: Can I sort the items?
questions.answer: Yes, you can manually reorder items within a section using the drag-and-drop handles in the editor.

questions.question: Can I edit my Resume?
questions.answer: Absolutely! You can log in to your account at any time to edit, update, or create new versions of your resume.

questions.question: Is my Resume also available for download in Word?
questions.answer: Currently, we prioritize PDF for consistent formatting across devices, but we are working on a Word export feature.

questions.question: Can I add a picture to my Resume?
questions.answer: Yes, most of our templates support a profile picture. You can upload and crop it directly in the editor.
